featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a co-working space nestled in the heart of SoBo. Not many know about this place because I was told that everyone who comes here comes through word of mouth.
It is an amazing place, the one you will fall in love with. Very close to CSMT station and a cool working space. They have a canteen and a conference room. I had gone for a conference and this room can be used for conducting workshops and small formal get togethers also.
The price for space is a bit on higher side because the space offers such ambience and facilities.

featured_reviews.name: Lizzie Chapman
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hands down the best co working space in Mumbai (maybe the world??). It's truly a joy to work here and I feel so much more creative and productive after a day in Ministry (what are these magic vibes!). The space is absolutely stunning, but it's also really clean, comfortable and we'll maintained. Bathrooms are clean and plentiful, WiFi works like a dream, noise levels are low and Aircon is just right. so all the basics are taken care of allowing you to focus on your work. The cafe is also brilliant, so you never need to leave. Literally. Do try the chicken ramen and the home made ice tea. 😋

It's all the small touches that make this place so magical. The complimentary water with mint added, the endless tea and coffee, the brilliant community events, the daily birthday celebrations for members. And most of all the COMMUNITY and how people come together to help and support each other with their work. It's truly like a utopian future of work!!

Become a MON member, it will change your life. 💕

featured_reviews.name: Aliabbas Delhiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Stars - Exceptional Co-Working Experience

I've been working at Ministry of New for several months now as a lawyer, and I couldn't be happier with this space. The entire facility is impeccably maintained - everything from the main work areas to the washrooms is spotlessly clean and well-lit with fantastic natural lighting throughout.
What really sets this place apart are the thoughtful amenities. The zoom pod is perfect for my client calls and video conferences, and there's no additional charge for using it. They also have a spacious common area that's ideal for meetings and calls, again at no extra cost. When I need a more formal setting, their conference room easily accommodates 10-12 people, and they generously include 5 hours of usage monthly plus complimentary tea and coffee.
Marlies, who owns and manages the space, is absolutely wonderful. Her attention to detail and genuine care for the space and its members really shows. The entire staff is incredibly friendly and professional.
This is exactly what a co-working space should be - professional, well-maintained, and thoughtfully designed. Highly recommended!

owner_posts.post_text:
A small appreciation post for our community.

Some days, it's the little things that make a workspace special.
A morning coffee, a productive meeting, a familiar face, or a walk through the streets of Colaba after a busy day.

At Hour Space, we're grateful to be surrounded by the energy and heritage of South Mumbai. Located near the Gateway of India, the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, and Colaba Causeway, our coworking space has become home to a wonderful community of entrepreneurs, freelancers, creatives, and professionals.

Thank you to everyone who chooses to work, create, collaborate, and grow with us. We love being part of your journey.

A little corner we love

There's a softness to this boutique coworking space in Colaba with warm tones and natural texture that makes you want to slow down before you walk through.

Calm, but characterful. Cosy, but never cluttered. It's the kind of aesthetic detail that makes Hour Space feel less like an office and more like an upgrade to working from home.

Every corner here is designed with intention because where you work should feel as good as it looks.

Check out our website to find the space that works for you because at Hour Space we have a space for all.

H - OUR  neighbourhood

We're proud to call one of Mumbai's most iconic neighbourhoods our home.
Nestled in the heart of Colaba, Hour Space is surrounded by some of the city's most celebrated landmarks - from the majestic Gateway of India and the historic Taj Mahal Palace Hotel to the vibrant lanes of Colaba Causeway. The rich heritage, culture, and energy of this neighbourhood inspire us every day.

At Hour Space, we strive to create more than just a workspace. We aim to build a community where entrepreneurs, professionals, creatives, and teams can come together to work, collaborate, and grow. Being located in such a dynamic part of the city allows us to connect with a diverse network of people and businesses, making every day a unique experience.

Whether you're looking for a productive coworking space, a venue for your next event, or simply a fresh perspective in one of Mumbai's most beautiful neighbourhoods, we'd love to welcome you.

Thank you to our members, neighbours, and partners for being part of our journey. We look forward to continuing to grow alongside the incredible community that makes Colaba so special.

A day of learning and exploration at Hour Space

We recently welcomed students from Sharnbasva University, Karnataka to Hour Space for a visit focused on colonial architecture and the urban character of Colaba.

Located in the heart of South Mumbai, our coworking space often becomes a place for conversations that go beyond work. It was a pleasure to host a curious group of students and share our space while they explored one of Mumbai's most architecturally rich neighbourhoods.

Elevate Your Executive Presence

Your team finally has a place to call their own. Hour Space's 4 seater cabin is the coworking space upgrade built for small teams who need more than a hot desk - a consistent, private spot where real work actually happens, day after day.
The enclosed space keeps the noise out and the focus in. High speed connectivity, ergonomic seating, and a setup that's always ready means your team can walk in, settle in, and get straight to what matters. No sorting out logistics, no fighting for a quiet corner - just your people, doing their best work.
It's a dedicated base for a growing team, without the weight of a full office lease. Run your standup, stay and build. Catch up over coffee, then ship something. The 4 seater cabin grows with you, at whatever pace you need.
At Hour Space, we take care of the space. You take care of the work.

And when you need a breather, our outdoor area is right there waiting.
Because sometimes, the best work happens after a moment outside.

Your Private Productivity Hub

Unlock your team’s potential and take your start-up to the next level! This enclosed cabin is more than just an office; it’s a high-performance sanctuary designed to foster deep focus, seamless efficiency, and meaningful collective working. By eliminating the typical distractions of an open-plan environment, this space allows you and your partner to dive deep into complex projects without interruption. Whether you are whiteboarding your next big pivot or crunching numbers for a seed round, the quiet intimacy of this cabin ensures that your best ideas stay within your walls until they are ready to be shared with the world.

Beyond mere privacy, the 2-seater cabin is engineered to spark the kind of synergy that only happens in close quarters. It provides the ideal setting for spontaneous brainstorming and rapid-fire decision-making, allowing for a "flow state" that is often lost in larger, louder settings. At Hour Space, we believe that the right environment acts as a catalyst for growth. By choosing this dedicated sanctuary, you aren't just renting a desk; you are securing a professional home base that reflects your team's ambition and commitment to excellence.

And when you need a breather, our outdoor area is right there waiting. 
Because sometimes, the best work happens after a moment outside.

Work and Wellness - Impact of Aesthetic Spaces

There's something about a co-working space that's been thoughtfully put together - the way it quietly shifts your mood before you've even opened your laptop.
The soft hum of focused work around you. Natural light. Greenery at the edges of your vision. People nearby who are just as deep in their work as you are. It doesn't feel like a big deal until you notice how much better your day went.
That's the thing about aesthetic spaces - they don't just look good. They make you feel good. And when you feel good, the work follows.
At Hour Space, that's never been an accident. Every corner has been designed with your well being in mind just as much as your productivity - because the two were never meant to be separate.
Come work somewhere that works for you.

It started with a promise. When we were in the thick of construction - walls going up, ideas taking shape. We told you we were building something different. Not just another coworking space, but a place designed around the way you actually work.
And now, we're adding that layer.
Introducing our private 2-seater and 4-seater cabins -  fully enclosed, beautifully finished headquarters for the ones who need to put their heads down and build. Comfortable, aesthetic, distraction-free, and completely yours -  with ample storage and a setup that means business without feeling corporate.
From the open-air energy of our cozy courtyard to the focused quiet of your own private cabin - Hour Space now holds every part of your workday. And trust us, we're not done yet.
For the freelancers, the founders, the small teams ready to stop settling - your office is ready.
Come see what we've been building for you because at Hour Space, we have a space for all.

Introducing our newly reimagined workspace where thoughtful design meets everyday functionality. With biophilic touches, refined aesthetics, and a warm, cozy atmosphere, the space has been carefully crafted to elevate your overall experience.

Our new layout brings new spaces offering more options, allowing you to move seamlessly between productivity and relaxation. Each detail reflects our commitment to keeping aesthetics in mind, always ensuring a perfect balance between form and function.

Because workspaces don’t have to be boring, we’ve created an environment that inspires, comforts, and adapts to you. Whether you’re working, meeting, or unwinding, this is a space designed to support it all.

The Garden Pop-Up serves as a restorative and inspiring cornerstone of the workspace. Guests and teams alike can step onto the sky-terrace to enjoy the fresh sea breeze and panoramic water views, providing an immediate sense of clarity. With its vibrant greenery, hand-painted tropical murals, and Mediterranean-inspired atmosphere, the space is designed to help professionals disconnect from the digital grind and recharge.

Beyond the view, the terrace fosters a unique culture of collaboration. Many of the community's best ideas are born not at desks, but over shared meals at the long lunch tables or during casual conversations under the woven lights. From the rustic textures to the cheerful yellow seating, every detail of the terrace is curated to help members feel balanced, inspired, and ready for their next breakthrough.

Worked from the Nariman Point branch using an Ondemand Day Pass.

The overall experience was great.

Cafeteria had a well designed seating options and provided good selection of teas and coffee options, hot&cold water as well as disposable cutlery for food.

featured_reviews.name: Chintani Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Summary: No space for discussion, no space for silence!

They have no space to take calls except for 3 uncomfortable phone booths. These do not fulfill the requirement of such a large office, so people have no option but to take calls elsewhere - which is not permitted!

There is no space except the pantry for a team to have short discussions. I understand the need to book a meeting room for a formal meeting, but how does a team function without any conversation all day?

Worst of all, they advertise 'Silent Zone' on their website. However, people have full-fledged, loud discussions and calls in these zones. When we inform the staff, we are told to mention specific cabin numbers, write e-mails, etc. Is it our responsibility to report others throughout the day?

They have a lovely deck overlooking the ocean, but they restrict entry to it! Instead of creating a progressive system to monitor authorized entry to the workspace, they decide to add restrictions at every stage, which makes the work experience rather unpleasant.

The location gives this the potential to become the best co-working space in the city. If they would simply demarcate one Silent Zone for people who actually need silence and open other spaces for in-team discussions, collaboration would become very simple indeed.

P.S. - I guess those who have booked full cabins for their company have a slightly better experience in terms of calls/silence, but I don't think others should be treated as second-class citizens or lured with the promise of a Silent Zone, which is anything but one!

P.P.S. - Also, they have really bad coffee and tea!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Loved it! After being cooped up at home for almost 2 years thanks to WFH my workplace decided to let us opt for WeWork and I'm absolutely loving it here.

The staff is so, so friendly. Always a smile for me everytime. I'll get there names one of these days. Super helpful and cooperative.

I think the only downside is the non availability of snacks. I'm sure nobody would mind paying for a packer of chips or biscuits if it's around but then again it would be a hygiene concern so I understand if they're a little apprehensive about it which is understandable.

Exceptional Staff: The staff at Dextrus are not just helpful but genuinely passionate about creating a conducive work environment. They are always available to assist with any requests, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Convenient Location: Situated in a prime location, Dextrus is easily accessible with plenty of nearby dining options. The parking facilities are a bonus for those who drive.

Clean and Safe: Even amidst COVID-19 concerns, Dextrus maintains a high level of cleanliness and enforces safety measures. I felt comfortable working here during these challenging times.

Flexibility: Dextrus offers a range of flexible membership options, which is perfect for freelancers, entrepreneurs, or remote workers. You can choose a plan that suits your needs and budget.

I can confidently say that Dextrus has raised the bar for coworking spaces. It's more than just a place to work; it's a community of like-minded individuals striving for success. If you're looking for a workspace that combines productivity, comfort, and networking opportunities, Dextrus should be at the top of your list. I can't wait to go back and make the most of this fantastic space.
